title: Digital Twins for Multi-Agent Systems: When to Trust, What to Change
abstract: arXiv:2611.28517v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Digital twins of agent networks need to flag unreliable forecasts and help users choose interventions. Both decisions depend on what happens over several steps: an error can spread through the network, and an edit whose trajectory is easy to predict may still yield a poor collective outcome. We ask when information about error propagation improves failure detection and whether a learned twin can select effective network edits despite imperfect forecasts. We propose Propagation-Aware Validation for Networked Digital Twins (PAV-Twin). Its monitor combines Jacobian-based propagation features with recent errors and ensemble disagreement to estimate the risk that a forecast exceeds an error threshold. Its planner simulates each candidate edit and ranks the edits by their predicted collective outcomes. translated_title: 面向多智能体系统的数字孪生：何时信任，如何改变
translated_abstract: 智能体网络的数字孪生需要标记不可靠的预测，并帮助用户选择干预措施。这两种决策都取决于多步之后发生的情况：误差可能在网络中传播扩散，而一个轨迹容易预测的编辑仍可能带来糟糕的集体结果。我们研究误差传播信息何时能够改进故障检测，以及学习得到的数字孪生能否在预测不完美的情况下选择有效的网络编辑。我们提出了面向网络化数字孪生的传播感知验证方法PAV-Twin。其监视器将基于雅可比矩阵的传播特征与近期误差和集成分歧相结合，以估计预测超出误差阈值的风险。其规划器对每个候选编辑进行模拟仿真，并根据预测的集体结果对编辑进行排序。在仿真实验中，在具有熟悉拓扑的较大振荡器网络上，监视器的精确率-召回率曲线下面积提升了0.13……
tldr: 提出PAV-Twin框架，其监视器结合雅可比传播特征、近期误差与集成分歧来检测数字孪生预测的失效风险，其规划器通过模拟候选编辑并按预测集体结果排序，从而为多智能体网络选择有效的干预措施。
en_tdlr: Proposes PAV-Twin, a framework whose monitor detects unreliable digital twin forecasts by combining Jacobian-based propagation features with recent errors and ensemble disagreement, and whose planner simulates candidate edits and ranks them by predicted collective outcomes to select effective interventions in multi-agent networks.
